<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) indicates ~8 carbons. The formula C₈H₁₄O matches this mass (126.104 Da) and the observed isotopic distribution best, with a small mass error within typical instrument tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
